title: Kusche and Steyn Shatter Records and Cash In at 2026 Comrades Marathon
claims: George Kusche won the 2026 men's race in 5:15:56, breaking the previous Up Run record of 5:24:49 set by Leonid Shvetsov in 2008.
Gerda Steyn won the 2026 women's race in 5:44:53, improving her own women's Up Run record of 5:49:46 set in 2024.
The 2026 route was 85.777 km, 133 metres shorter than in 2024 and the shortest Up Run distance in recorded history.
The 2026 race was the 99th edition of the Comrades Marathon and the 50th Up Run, with 18,523 finishers.
Both 2026 winners earned R2,322,000 each, including first-place prize money, first South African bonus, Up Run record incentive and Best Average Pace bonus.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取 CMA 2026 赛后官方博客，抄录 Up Run 男女纪录、85.777 km、99 届/第 50 次 Up Run、18,523 完赛人数；同日尝试官方成绩门户 results.finishtime.co.za，被机器人校验挡住，未能读取；女子 Down 5:44:54 与 Up 5:44:53 分别由 CMA Race Information 页和本赛后稿确认。
